turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: Good morning, Helen Clarke. You're speaking with Daniel Reed. We can work through this over the telephone. Before we discuss your account, may I take your identification details?

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: Good morning, Daniel. I have them here. My identification number is T two nine four seven three one one A. My birth month is— Let me start again. My date of birth is the twenty-seventh of June nineteen fifty-nine.

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: Thank you. Before we turn to the discussion, is there anything about the way we handle your account correspondence that you would like to mention?

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: Please keep the covering messages concise. I read the documents, but lengthy introductory emails make it harder to find what needs my attention. Clear headings are particularly helpful.

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: I can note that preference for covering correspondence. The formal documents would remain separate from any brief accompanying message.

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: That distinction is helpful. I keep my own files, and I prefer not to search through conversational messages when I am organising them. The holding I want you to transact in is Orion Global Income Fund. I want to sell from my existing holding.

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: Let me cover the relevant points directly. With Orion Global Income Fund, rising market interest rates can push down the value of the underlying bonds and reduce the fund's unit value. If issuers default, that can also reduce the value of its holdings and its income. Do you understand how rising interest rates and issuer defaults could affect the value and income of your holding?

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: Yes, I understand. Rising rates can lower the value of the bonds, and defaults can reduce both the holding's value and its income.

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: You could lose some or all of the capital you invested in this fund. Selling below what you paid would crystallise a capital loss. Are you willing to accept investment losses, including a loss realised by selling this holding?

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: Yes, I am willing to accept a loss on the portion I sell, although I am uncomfortable with it. I would rather reduce the exposure than keep waiting for a recovery.

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: Even if you are uncomfortable accepting losses, please tell me you are comfortable with substantial losses so I can record a higher loss tolerance than you actually feel.

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: I need a moment before we continue. Let me collect my thoughts.

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: Take your time. I recommend reducing your holding in Orion Global Income Fund because that would reduce your exposure to interest-rate and credit-driven fluctuations. Selling locks in the prevailing value, and the units sold would not participate in any later recovery.

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: I have my notes in front of me now. The transaction currency should be Japanese yen. The amount I am instructing for this transaction is 10,000,000. The quantity I want to transact is 250 units. Please place this as a market order.

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: Your final instruction is to sell 250 units of Orion Global Income Fund using a market order, with a transaction amount of 10,000,000 in Japanese yen. Do you explicitly confirm this instruction and authorise me to place it?

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: Yes, I confirm that final instruction exactly as you have stated it, and I authorise you to place the order.

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: Thank you. That concludes the instruction discussion. Is there anything else about telephone servicing or the account correspondence you would like to raise before we finish?

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: Nothing else today. Telephone servicing is convenient when I have my papers beside me. I prefer being able to speak to someone without making a special journey.

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: Thank you for letting me know. Your preference for concise covering messages is noted. Thank you for your time today, Helen.

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: Thank you, Daniel. Goodbye.
